title: Who can put the ball back?
question: If you ask another player to mark and lift your ball for you, who is allowed to put the ball back on its spot afterwards?

choices.text: Only the player whose ball it is
Only the person who marked and picked up the ball
Either the player or the person who picked it up

explanation: Either the person who marked and lifted the ball or the player themselves can put the ball back on its spot.
imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer on the putting green gestures to a friend who is picking up her marked golf ball to clean it.
imageAlt: Teenage golfer having her ball marked and picked up by another player on the green.
